name: AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval
disjWithin
result.value:
:=
  {E : ℕ × (ℕ → ℝ × ℝ) |
    (∀ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, (E.2 i).1 ∈ uIcc a b ∧ (E.2 i).2 ∈ uIcc a b) ∧
      Set.PairwiseDisjoint (Finset.range E.1) (fun i ↦ uIoc (E.2 i).1 (E.2 i).2)}
result.informal_description: The set $ E $ consists of a finite collection of intervals $ [x_i, y_i] $ contained in $ [a, b] $, where each interval has endpoints in $ [a, b] $ and all intervals are pairwise disjoint in their interiors. Formally, $ E $ is a pair $ (n, f) $ where $ f $ maps indices $ 1, ..., n $ to interval endpoints such that: (1) all interval endpoints lie within $ [a, b] $, and (2) the family of intervals $ (\min(x_i,y_i), \max(x_i,y_i)] $ forms a pairwise disjoint collection.

name: Finset
card_le_card_biUnion
result.signature:
{s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Finset α} (hs : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).Nonempty) :
  #s ≤ #(s.biUnion f)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Finset α},
  (↑s).PairwiseDisjoint f → (∀ i ∈ s, (f i).Nonempty) → s.card ≤ (s.biUnion f).card
result.value:
:= by
  rw [card_biUnion hs, card_eq_sum_ones]
  exact sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ (hf i hi).card_pos
result.informal_name: Cardinality of Finite Set is Bounded by Indexed Union of Pairwise Disjoint Non-Empty Sets
result.informal_description: Let $ s $ be a finite set and $ f : s \to \text{Finset}(\alpha) $ a function such that the family $ \{f(i)\}_{i \in s} $ is pairwise disjoint and each $ f(i) $ is non-empty. Then, the cardinality of $ s $ satisfies $ |s| \leq \left| \bigcup_{i \in s} f(i) \right| $.

name: Finset
disjoint_empty_left
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} (s : Finset α), Disjoint ∅ s
result.informal_name: The Empty Set is Disjoint from Every Finite Set
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $, the empty set $ \emptyset $ and $ s $ are disjoint, meaning their intersection is empty.

name: Finset
card_le_card_biUnion_add_one
result.signature: {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Finset α} (hf : Injective f) (hs : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f) : #s ≤ #(s.biUnion f) + 1
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Finset α},
  Function.Injective f → (↑s).PairwiseDisjoint f → s.card ≤ (s.biUnion f).card + 1
result.value:
:= by
  grw [card_le_card_biUnion_add_card_fiber hs,
    card_le_one.2 fun _ hi _ hj ↦ hf <| (mem_filter.1 hi).2.trans (mem_filter.1 hj).2.symm]
result.informal_name: Cardinality of Finite Set is Bounded by Indexed Union Plus One
result.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ and an injective function $ f : s \to \text{Finset}(\alpha) $ with pairwise disjoint images, the cardinality of $ s $ satisfies $ |s| \leq |\bigcup_{a \in s} f(a)| + 1 $.

name: Finset
card_le_diff_of_interleaved
result.signature:
{s t : Finset α} (h : ∀ᵉ (x ∈ s) (y ∈ s), x < y → (∀ z ∈ s, z ∉ Set.Ioo x y) → ∃ z ∈ t, x < z ∧ z < y) :
  s.card ≤ (t \ s).card + 1
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s t : Finset α},
  (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x < y → (∀ z ∈ s, z ∉ Set.Ioo x y) → ∃ z ∈ t, x < z ∧ z < y) → s.card ≤ (t \ s).card + 1
result.value:
:=
  card_le_of_interleaved fun x hx y hy hxy hs =>
    let ⟨z, hzt, hxz, hzy⟩ := h x hx y hy hxy hs
    ⟨z, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzt, fun hzs => hs z hzs ⟨hxz, hzy⟩⟩, hxz, hzy⟩
result.informal_name: Cardinality Bound for Interleaved Finite Sets
result.informal_description: Let $ s $ and $ t $ be finite subsets of a linearly ordered type $ \alpha $. If for every pair of elements $ x < y $ in $ s $ with no other elements of $ s $ in the open interval $ (x, y) $, there exists an element $ z \in t $ such that $ x < z < y $, then the cardinality of $ s $ satisfies $ |s| \leq |t \setminus s| + 1 $.

name: pow_right_strictAnti₀
result.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M₀] {a : M₀} [PosMulStrictMono M₀],
  0 < a → a < 1 → StrictAnti fun x => a ^ x
result.value:
:=
  strictAnti_nat_of_succ_lt fun n => by
    have : ZeroLEOneClass M₀ := ⟨(h₀.trans h₁).le⟩
    simpa only [pow_succ, mul_one] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h₁ (pow_pos h₀ n)
result.informal_description: For any base $a$ satisfying $0 < a < 1$, the exponential function $f(x) = a^x$ is strictly decreasing, meaning that for all $x < y$, $a^y < a^x$.

name: NNReal
pow_antitone_exp
result.signature: {a : ℝ≥0} (m n : ℕ) (mn : m ≤ n) (a1 : a ≤ 1) : a ^ n ≤ a ^ m
result.type: ∀ {a : NNReal} (m n : ℕ), m ≤ n → a ≤ 1 → a ^ n ≤ a ^ m
result.informal_description: For any non-negative real number $ a $ satisfying $ 0 \leq a \leq 1 $ and natural numbers $ m \leq n $, the inequality $ a^n \leq a^m $ holds.

name: pow_lt_pow_right_of_lt_one₀
result.signature: (h₀ : 0 < a) (h₁ : a < 1) (hmn : m < n) : a ^ n < a ^ m
result.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M₀] {a : M₀} {m n : ℕ} [PosMulStrictMono M₀],
  0 < a → a < 1 → m < n → a ^ n < a ^ m
result.informal_name: Strict Decrease of Exponentiation for Bases Less Than One
result.informal_description: For any element $a$ in a linear ordered commutative group with zero, if $0 < a < 1$ and $m < n$ are natural numbers, then $a^n < a^m$.

name: pow_right_anti₀
result.signature: [PosMulMono M₀] (ha₀ : 0 ≤ a) (ha₁ : a ≤ 1) : Antitone (fun n : ℕ ↦ a ^ n)
result.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : Preorder M₀] {a : M₀} [PosMulMono M₀],
  0 ≤ a → a ≤ 1 → Antitone fun n => a ^ n
result.value:
:=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun n ↦ by
    have : ZeroLEOneClass M₀ := ⟨ha₀.trans ha₁⟩
    rw [← mul_one (a ^ n), pow_succ]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha₁ (pow_nonneg ha₀ n)
result.informal_name: Right Exponentiation is Antitone for $0 \leq a \leq 1$ in Ordered Monoid with Zero
result.informal_description: For any element $a$ in an ordered monoid with zero satisfying $0 \leq a \leq 1$, the function $f(n) = a^n$ is antitone, meaning that for all natural numbers $n \leq m$, it holds that $a^m \leq a^n$.

name: zpow_right_strictAnti₀
result.signature: (ha₀ : 0 < a) (ha₁ : a < 1) : StrictAnti fun n : ℤ ↦ a ^ n
result.type:
∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder G₀] [PosMulReflectLT G₀] {a : G₀}
  [ZeroLEOneClass G₀], 0 < a → a < 1 → StrictAnti fun n => a ^ n
result.value:
:= by
  refine strictAnti_int_of_succ_lt fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [zpow_add_one₀ ha₀.ne']
  exact mul_lt_of_lt_one_right (zpow_pos ha₀ _) ha₁
result.informal_name: Strict Decreasingness of Integer Exponentiation for 0 < a < 1
result.informal_description: For any real number $a$ satisfying $0 < a < 1$, the function $f(n) = a^n$ is strictly decreasing in the integer variable $n$. This means that for all integers $m < n$, we have $a^n < a^m$.
